title: File Upload Guide
content:
Customers can upload files through the web application and API.

Uploads are rejected when the current storage usage plus the incoming file size exceeds the account storage quota.

When an upload is rejected because of storage capacity, the API returns HTTP 403 with the error code quota_limit.

title: Storage Quotas
content:
Every customer account has a storage quota determined by its subscription plan.

Enterprise customers can request additional storage capacity from support.

Removing old files immediately frees storage capacity for new uploads.

title: Upload Permissions
content:
Workspace administrators can disable file uploads for individual users.

When uploads are disabled by an administrator, the API returns HTTP 403 with the error code upload_not_allowed.

title: File Size Limits
content:
Individual files must not exceed 5 GB.

Files larger than the maximum supported size are rejected with HTTP 413 payload_too_large.
